title: Epoch Manifest
description: v0.9.0 §25.3 S5 (RQ-10, #1853) — the operator-signed, verify-only manifest that freezes the evaluation panel + utility weights for one epoch. `ai-memory epoch-apply` verifies the operator signature over the canonical CBOR of {epoch_seq, prior_epoch_id, policy_seq, policy_digest_hex, content_sha256(canonical JSON of this file), created_at}, checks epoch_seq == prior + 1 and the policy binding against the live current_policy_version(), then writes the triple anchor (this signed file + a resolved EpochAdvance checkpoint + an epoch.manifest_applied audit row) under ONE SHA-256. The manifest STRUCTURALLY CANNOT assert diversity/decorrelation: no such field exists (explicitly reserved-absent), so a manifest cannot launder unattested diversity. The runtime contract is the serde struct in src/; this schema is the git-tracked documentation contract, asserted schema-vs-struct-conformant in tests/ ONLY (never include_str!'d from src/).

epoch_seq.description: Monotonic epoch sequence. Must equal the last applied epoch_seq + 1 at apply time.

prior_epoch_id.description: The id of the epoch this one succeeds. Empty string for the genesis epoch.

policy_seq.description: The governance policy sequence this manifest binds to. Apply REFUSES a manifest whose policy binding != the live current_policy_version() (stale-policy manifests are dead on arrival).

policy_digest_hex.description: Lowercase-hex whole-ruleset governance policy digest at freeze time.

slots.description: The frozen panel slots for this epoch.

utility_weights.description: The utility weights, frozen for the epoch's duration.

frozen_within_epoch.description: MUST be true — utility weights do not change within an epoch.

created_at.description: RFC3339 creation instant, inside the signed surface.

content_hash.description: Lowercase-hex SHA-256 over the canonical JSON bytes of this manifest (excluding the signature envelope). The triple anchor shares this hash.
